analysis.reason: RSI 41.7로 과매도 구간 탈출 신호, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 확인. 그러나 SMA5(30,568)가 현재가(29,945) 위에 위치하며 저항으로 작용. 5일 연속 거래량비 1.0 미만으로 매수세 부재. 따라서 관망 유지.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (34.1→41.7): 과매도 구간 탈출, 중립 구간 진입 중
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-851.8579→52.9939): 약세 수렴 지속, 바닥 다지기 시도

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 29,945) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 30,568/32,774/34,816): below short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 38,227/36,393): below long-term trend, in weak territory
· 52-week position (33.1%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.1→41.7): exiting oversold, entering neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-851.8579→52.9939): weak convergence continues, attempting to build a base
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 32,774): trading near the middle band, 52.27% band width suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 29,075): above 5-day low, above Pivot S1 (KRW 24,465)
· Swing Resistance (KRW 30,570): close to SMA5 (KRW 30,568), acting as short-term resistance
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (sideways): no trend reversal signal confirmed
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.62): below 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI attempts rebound but lacks volume, buy entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see stance
